title: Perturbation triplets: larger memory M and pruning to K terms (closed form)
question: Does the T3 + FIR quality keep growing beyond M = 21, and how few triplet terms keep it (RM vs quality)?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
pruning: per bootstrap replica: full T3 + FIR7 fit at M = 25 (lambda by validation); terms ranked by |C_j| * rms(feature_j) on train; the K strongest terms + the 7 FIR taps refitted from the sub-matrix, lambda by validation
rm: sym: 12 per merged triplet term + 4 L (E031)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.memory: growth with M continues if T3 + FIR7 at M = 31 - M = 21 (E031) >= 1 p.p. (test mean, 5 replicas)
rule_draft.pruning: K = 128 terms keep >= 90 % of the reduction of the full M = 25 model
rule_draft.vs_networks: pruned triplets beat the Kerr MLP at equal RM if Q2 gain difference >= 0.1 dB with non-overlapping intervals (checked in E033 with the E025 recipes)
